text: While holding this 10-foot pole, you can use an action to speak a com- mand word and cause it to collapse into a 1-foot-long rod, for ease of stor- age. The pole’s weight doesn’t change. You can use an action to speak a different command word and cause the rod to revert to a pole; however, the rod will elongate only as far as the surrounding space allows. ‘ * MAGIC ITEM -
